question: How sensitive are source-labelled separate RNA and ATAC transformed-mean contrast directions and conditional precision to explicit mapping, offset and within-assay dependence assumptions in the qualified external reference?
decision: Provide a bounded measurement benchmark over deposited feature universes without claiming an exact author replay, NAM validation, TF activity or a genotype/target screen.
strongest_rival: Compositional normalization, low-count offsets, one-to-many mapping, annotation selection, unknown dependence/timing/batches and invalid precision interpretations can generate apparent cross-assay differences.
discriminator: All non-all-zero deposited features, two fixed offsets, two auditable source mappings, explicit nearest-TSS distance sensitivity, and separate independent-Welch/all-pairing conditional intervals with exact eligibility denominators.
exposure_record: Anchor NAM paper with N. brasiliensis-history/later-IAV context and repository outcomes are exposed. Reference paper outcomes, source metadata, matrix headers/first rows and annotation schema are exposed. No reference count effects have been computed; this is a prospective descriptive benchmark after E1 qualification of a non-infectious cultured-macrophage reference. E1 qualification outputs and annotation coverage are exposed. E2 descriptive contrasts have not been computed.
biological_unit: Source-reported mouse/preparation biological replicates within each assay group; exact across-condition reuse and cross-assay pairing are unknown. Gene-region rows and repeated gene mappings are not independent biological units.
nesting_and_overlap: Separate source-labelled WT IL4 versus vehicle groups: three RNA libraries per condition and four ATAC libraries per condition. No within- or cross-assay pairing is asserted. Alternative full-pairing and independence assumptions do not exhaust partial-overlap or batch structures.
population_and_selection: WT source-labelled IL4 and vehicle columns only. Every non-all-zero deposited feature in these selected groups receives a descriptive contrast, including unannotated ATAC regions. All source rows stay in each library denominator. Annotation is used only at the cross-assay join stage.
contrast: Separate assay-specific condition-minus-control mean log2(CPM+offset) differences, offsets 1 and .5. These are compositional descriptive transformed-mean contrasts, not count-model log fold changes or absolute-output differences.
endpoint: Sample spread, conditional model intervals, all-pairing sensitivity envelope, full feature eligibility and mapped-pair-weighted sign/directional-envelope summaries. No subtraction of RNA and ATAC effect scales.
methods: Use all-source-feature library totals for CPM; retain all non-all-zero selected-group rows. Compute independent-Welch intervals and all 6 RNA/24 ATAC possible one-to-one pairing intervals. Numerical SE <=1e-12 is degenerate, not certainty. Envelope is a sensitivity bound over these declared models only. Join by exact author Ensembl IDs and exact nearest-TSS symbols; summarize both complete author mappings and absolute nearest-TSS distance <=2000bp. This distance refers to the source nearest TSS, not necessarily the gene in the different author-Ensembl mapping. Verify 40 evenly spaced source-order feature positions per assay/offset using scalar Python arithmetic and all pairings.
missingness_and_exclusions: Only all-zero selected-group features excluded from effect calculation; no expression/variance/outcome-based threshold, outlier or locus selection. Retain all zero/undefined precision cases and unmapped-region effect results. Source annotation universe and author filtered flag are reported separately. No guessed annotation version, duration correction, animal identity or recovered batch.
multiplicity: No biological p-values, FDR decisions, equivalence labels or locus ranking. Mapping fractions are dependent pair-row descriptive summaries; no binomial confidence intervals over genes/peaks.
precision_basis: 95-percent model-conditional intervals assume normal transformed sample observations and the specified dependence model. Unknown pairing/partial overlap/batches prevent unconditional population-CI claims. No biological effect margin or power claim.
interpretation_limit: Published outcomes and source tables are exposed. Source 24h/25h conflict, annotation-version ambiguity and unknown preparation/batch dependence remain. No causal duration-matched interpretation, exact edgeR reproduction, global absolute-output inference, activity/occupancy/mediation result or original NAM hold resolution.
stop_rule: Stop on source/hash/eligibility/verification disagreement. Retain all outcomes and degenerate models. Do not tune offsets, mapping rules or source exclusions after exposure, and do not expand to genotype or selected-axis analyses.
amendment_reason: New owner-authorized E2 descriptive reference benchmark after E1; preserves all earlier frozen sources and NAM holds.
